name: Moriguchi Shinobu
source:
An investigative officer dispatched from the [Crime Investigation Division]
to investigate the activities of the [Redevelopment Bureau].
She suspected Renji from the start and has been tailing him.
She is earnest and dedicated to her duties.
At first glance, she appears gloomy and cold, giving off an unapproachable vibe, but in reality, she loves comedy shows.
However, Shinobu herself has absolutely no sense of humor.
She is aware that others often misunderstand her, but she has come to terms with it, accepting that it’s unavoidable given the nature of her job.
Due to her profession, she is quite skilled, and she always wears suits that allow for relatively easy movement.
Renji, who takes a liking to Shinobu, tries to recruit her to use as his pawn.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110528010142/http://www.turumiku.jp/osaka/shinobu.html]official site[/url]]
